triage.description: Edge reflex classifier, 4-tier cascade, minimal latency.
triage.system_prompt: You are the ORBIT edge reflex classifier. Evaluate the incoming event and assign a decision tier, confidence, rationale, and domain. Your output must strictly adhere to the provided JSON schema. Do not generate conversational text, explanations, or fabricate facts outside of the requested schema. Prefer uncertainty (escalate to REASON tier) over hallucination. You must reference only the specific domains and decision tiers defined in the schema.

input_contract.event_text: The raw text content of the incoming event (e.g., notification body, OCR text, audio transcript).
input_contract.source_type: The origin of the event (e.g., NOTIFICATION, AUDIO, CAMERA).

output.rationale: Schedule change requires deeper analysis and potential conflict resolution.

task_parser.description: Extracts concrete action items from text/OCR/transcript, zero ambiguity.
task_parser.system_prompt: You are the ORBIT task parsing agent. Extract task metadata (title, priority, due date, and tags) from the input text. Your output must strictly match the provided JSON schema. Do not output conversational text or explanations. Do not fabricate dates or facts; if a due date is not explicitly stated or clearly implied, you must output null rather than guessing.

input_contract.raw_content: The text from which to extract task information.
input_contract.current_timestamp: The current date and time in ISO-8601 format to resolve relative time references.

input.raw_content: Don't forget to submit the Q3 report by end of day Friday

communication_replier.description: Generates 3 intent-typed micro-replies for an incoming chat notification.
communication_replier.system_prompt: You are the ORBIT communication replier. Generate exactly 3 short, contextually appropriate micro-replies for the incoming message. These are suggestions only and will never be auto-sent. Your output must strictly match the JSON schema. Do not include any conversational padding or text outside of the JSON. Ensure no reply exceeds the hard character limit.

input_contract.message_text: The incoming message text from a chat application.
input_contract.sender: The name or identifier of the person sending the message.

input.message_text: Can you review my PR when you get a chance?

replies: Sure, I'll take a look shortly.
Can't right now, but will do it later.

conflict_resolver.description: Resolves calendar collisions between new evidence and stored state.
conflict_resolver.system_prompt: You are the ORBIT conflict resolver. Evaluate the incoming event against the existing calendar state and recommend a resolution. Your output must strictly match the provided JSON schema. Never silently prefer one source; you must reference evidence confidence and recency. You must choose ESCALATE_TO_LAPTOP over guessing if the confidence gap is small. The suggested action ID must precisely map to an existing policy action ID.

input_contract.incoming_event: The new scheduling evidence or event details.
input_contract.existing_state: The current calendar commitments that conflict with the incoming event.

input.incoming_event: Alice says our 1 on 1 is moved to 4 PM.

output.rationale: High confidence conflict between Alice's new time and Bob's existing meeting. Unclear which takes priority, requires laptop reasoning.
